name: Active Directory Legacy
description: This App is installed via automation.DO NOT DELETE since its shared.

panels.name: Topology
panels.queryString: _sourceCategory = Labs/Windows/OS/Windows "DomainController" | parse regex "^DomainController DName==\"(?<domainDN>[^ \"]+)\" DomainName==\"(?<domainName>[^\"]+)\" Forest==\"(?<forest>[^\"]+)\" NetBIOSName==\"(?<NetBiosName>[^\"]+)\" ControllerHostName==\"(?<dcHostName>[^\"]+)\" IP==\"(?<dcIP>[^ ]+)\" Site==\"(?<site>[^ ]+)\"" | count by forest,site,domainDN,NetBiosName | fields - _count

panels.name: Organizational Units per Domain
panels.queryString: _sourceCategory = Labs/Windows/OS/Windows "OU" | parse regex "^OU SearchBase==\"(?<searchBase>[^\"]+)\" DistinguishedName==\"(?<ouDN>[^\"]+)\" Name==\"(?<ouName>[^\"]+)\" ObjectGUID==\"(?<ouGUID>[^ ]+)\"" | searchBase as domain | count_distinct(ouDN) as OrganizationalUnits by domain

panels.name: Groups per Domain
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/Windows/OS/Windows "Group" 
| parse regex "^Group SearchBase==\"(?<searchBase>[^\"]+)\" DistinguishedName==\"(?<groupDN>[^\"]+)\" Name==\"(?<groupName>[^\"]+)\" ObjectGUID==\"(?<groupGUID>[^ ]+)\" GroupCategory==\"(?<groupCat>[^\"]*)\"" | searchBase as Domain 
| count_distinct(groupDN) as groups by Domain,groupCat  | transpose row domain column groupCat as %"Security",%"Distribution"

panels.name: Computer OS per Domain
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/Windows/OS/Windows "Computer" 
| parse regex "^Computer SearchBase==\"(?<searchBase>[^\"]+)\" DistinguishedName==\"(?<computerDN>[^\"]+)\" Name==\"(?<computerName>[^\"]+)\" ObjectGUID==\"(?<computerGUID>[^ ]+)\" DNSHostName==\"(?<computerDNSName>[^\" ]+)\" OperatingSystem==\"(?<computerOS>[^\"]+)\" IPv4Address==\"(?<computerIP>[^ ]+)\"" 
| searchBase as domain
| count by domain,computerDN,computerName,computerGUID,computerDNSName,computerOS,computerIP 
| count as computers by computerOS,domain

panels.name: Top 10 Messages
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/Windows/OS/Windows Message 
| extract "Message = \"(?<msg>[^\r\.]+?)(?:\r|\.|\";)" nodrop
| extract "\sMessage = \"(?<msg>[^\"\n]+)\n" nodrop
| count by msg | sort by _count desc | limit 10

panels.name: Messages Over Time by Category
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/Windows/OS/Windows 
| parse "CategoryString = \"*\";" as category nodrop
| parse "Type = \"*\";" as msg_type
| timeslice 1h
| count by _timeslice, category
| transpose row _timeslice column category

panels.name: Object Creation
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/Windows/OS/Windows (4720 or 4741 or 4727 or 4731 or 4744 or 4749 or 4754 or 4759 or 4783 or 5137 or 4902 or 4790)
| parse "EventCode = *;" as event_id nodrop 
| if ((event_id in ("4720")), "user", "") as object_created
| if ((event_id in ("4720","4741")), "computer", "") as object_created
| if ((event_id in ("4727","4731","4744","4749","4754","4759","4783")), "group", object_created) as object_created
| if ((event_id in ("5137","4902","4790")), "object", object_created) as object_created
| where object_created != ""
| timeslice 1h
| count by object_created, _timeslice
| transpose row _timeslice column object_created

panels.name: Rights Management
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/Windows/OS/Windows (4705 or 4704)
| parse "EventCode = *;" as event_id nodrop 
| where event_id in ("4704", "4705")
| if ((event_id = "4704"), "assigned", if ((event_id = "4705"), "removed", "")) as right
| timeslice 1h
| count by right, _timeslice
| transpose row _timeslice column right

panels.name: Logon/off Activity
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/Windows/OS/Windows ("logon" or "logged off") ("4624" or "4634") ("EventCode = 4624;" or "EventCode = 4634;")
| parse "EventCode = *;" as event_id nodrop
| parse regex "Logfile = \"Security\";[\s\S]+?Logon Type:\s+(?<logon_type>\d+)\b"  nodrop
| where logon_type != "3"
| if (event_id = "4624" and logon_type = "2","interactive logon","") as type
| if (event_id = "4624" and logon_type = "10","remote logon",type) as type
| if (event_id = "4634" and logon_type = "2","interactive logged off",type) as type
| if (event_id = "4634" and logon_type = "10","remote logged off",type) as type
| timeslice 1h
| where type != ""
| count by _timeslice, type
| transpose row _timeslice column type

panels.name: Object Deletion
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/Windows/OS/Windows (4726 or 4743 or 4730 or 4734 or 4748 or 4753 or 4758 or 4763 or 4789 or 4659 or 4660 or 5141)
| parse "EventCode = *;" as event_id nodrop 
| if ((event_id in ("4726")), "user", "") as object_deleted
| if ((event_id in ("4743")), "computer", "") as object_deleted
| if ((event_id in ("4730","4734","4748","4753","4758","4763","4789")), "group", object_deleted) as object_deleted
| if ((event_id in ("4659","4660", "5141")), "object", object_deleted) as object_deleted
| where object_deleted != ""
| timeslice 1h
| count by object_deleted, _timeslice
| transpose row _timeslice column object_deleted

panels.name: Successes vs Failures
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/Windows/OS/Windows
| parse "ComputerName = \"*\";" as comp_name nodrop
| parse "Type = \"*\";" as msg_type
| extract "Message = \"(?<msg_summary>[^\r\.]+?)(?:\r|\.|\";)" nodrop
| if ((msg_type matches "*fail*" or msg_type matches "*Fail*"), "Failure","Success") as status
| timeslice 1h
| count as EventCount by  status, _timeslice
| transpose row _timeslice column status

panels.name: Audit Failures Over Time
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/Windows/OS/Windows "Audit Failure" "Type = \"Audit Failure\";"
| parse "Type = \"*\";" as msg_type nodrop
| parse "EventCode = *;" as event_id nodrop
| where msg_type="Audit Failure"
| timeslice 1h
| count as failures by _timeslice, event_id
| transpose row _timeslice column event_id

panels.name: Admin Activity by Category
All Failures by IP
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/Windows/OS/Windows ("failure" or "error") 
| parse regex "Logfile = \"Security\";[\s\S]+?Client Address:\s+(?<src_ip>[^\r]+?)\r[\s\S]+?Client Port:\s+?(?<src_port>[\d-]+)" nodrop 
| parse regex "Logfile = \"Security\";[\s\S]+?Source Network Address:\s+(?<src_ip>[^\r]+?)\r[\s\S]+?Source Port:\s+?(?<src_port>[\d-]+)" nodrop
| parse "Type = \"*\";" as msg_type nodrop
| where msg_type != "Audit Success" and src_ip != "" and src_ip != "-"
| count by src_ip
| sort by _count desc
| limit 10
